Title: Azure Active Directory B2C in China

Body.Content:
Azure Active Directory B2C in China is now in preview. More companies are doing business directly with Chinese customers, and supporting customer identity access within China is an important step in their digital transformation. We’re bringing all the capabilities of global Azure Active Directory B2C service to China, with the following added benefits:  

  • All your customer data stays within China. 
  • You stay compliant by using the Azure China cloud services (through 21Vianet).  
  • You enjoy faster performance by being closer to your customers and organization’s location. 
  • You’re able to use the most popular social identity providers in China like Weibo, QQ, and WeChat.  

Try it out
